newsitem.title: USA: Argyle says B. Byrne to retire as COO, pres.
newsitem.headline: Argyle says B. Byrne to retire as COO, pres.

text.p: Argyle Television Inc said Friday Blake Byrne will retire as president and chief operating officer after its merger with Hearst Broadcasting around September 1.
In a written statement, Byrne said he plans to remain a significant shareholder of Hearst-Argyle.
The company was not immediately able to provide information on who, if anyone, will replace Byrne.
Argyle Television, which now owns six network-affiliated stations, recently announced the merger with Hearst Broadcasting. The combined companies will be called Hearst-Argyle Television.
Assuming the maximum cash election, Argyle shareholders will get six million shares of Hearst-Argyle Television stock and $159.7 million in cash.
A company spokeswoman said they have not named a replacement for Byrne.
